notes: All figures below were sourced via web search of CBS press releases and reputable Israeli press coverage (Ynet, Calcalist, Nadlan Center, Times of Israel). PDFs on cbs.gov.il could not be parsed directly during this run; numbers attributed to CBS were cross-checked across at least two outlets where possible.
Important methodological caveats applied to refresh decisions:

1) CBS often publishes ROLLING 12-month windows (e.g., Oct 2024-Sep 2025) that are NOT directly substitutable for calendar-year DB rows. Such figures are recorded as 'reference only' and produce no refresh.

2) The CBS 'Average Housing Prices' table by district (Q3 2025 release) gives MEAN apartment prices per DISTRICT or large city. This is methodologically different from the DB's nadlan_price_trends (MEDIAN deal prices per city from nadlan.gov.il / Tax Authority). They are NOT interchangeable; no nadlan_price_trends refreshes are proposed unless a per-city median was published.
3) The CBS Housing Price Index (madad) reports relative % changes, not absolute prices, so it cannot refresh price_per_sqm fields directly.

4) CBS published 'אוכלוסיית ישראל בפתחה של שנת 2026' (Dec 2025) with the NATIONAL total only; per-city end-2025 estimates are typically released later in 2026 and were not located. No city.population_2026 refreshes proposed.

reports.topic: CBS Housing Price Index - Jan-Feb 2026 release
reports.publishedDate: 2026-04-15 (CBS publishes mid-month covering 2-month window of Jan-Feb 2026)
reports.summary: Jan-Feb 2026 housing price index: +0.1% vs Dec25-Jan26; annual change +1.7%. District YoY: Jerusalem +9.6%, Haifa +0.7%, Center -3.1%, Tel Aviv -1.9%, North +4.8%, South +1.4%. NEW-build prices +0.3% vs prior period.
reports.refreshNotes: The CBS Housing Price Index is index-based (relative % changes from a 2018 base), NOT absolute prices in shekels. It cannot directly refresh price_per_sqm_2026 fields in the city table without an explicit conversion methodology. Recommend leaving city.price_per_sqm_2026 values unchanged unless a per-city absolute-price table is sourced. The DISTRICT-level YoY signals (JLM +9.6%, TLV district -1.9%) are useful as context for any future re-extrapolation but should NOT be applied as a refresh in this pass.

reports.topic: Population of Israel at the start of 2026 (CBS year-end estimate)
reports.publishedDate: 2025-12 (CBS press release 'אוכלוסיית ישראל בפתחה של שנת 2026', PDF 01_25_422b)
reports.summary: Israel's population reached 10.178M at end of 2025 (+~112K, +1.1% YoY). Jewish & other: 7.771M (76.3%); Arab: 2.147M (21.1%); foreign: 0.260M (2.6%). Births 2025: ~182K. Emigration: 69.3K left, 19.0K returned.
reports.refreshNotes: This release contains the NATIONAL total only. Per-city end-2025 population estimates (which would refresh city.population_2026) are typically published by CBS as a separate Local Authorities report later in 2026 and were not found in this search. No city-level refreshes proposed. The DB's population_2026 column was already extrapolated using this exact methodology - the national +1.1% YoY is consistent.
